name: Workout Feed
subtitle: Planned workouts on your Apple Watch, from any feed URL.
description: Source for Workout Feed — an iOS app that keeps the Apple Watch's native Workout app stocked with your upcoming planned workouts, from any .workout feed URL you point it at.

apps.name: Workout Feed
apps.subtitle: Planned workouts on your Apple Watch, from any feed URL.
apps.localizedDescription: Point Workout Feed at a feed URL (a small JSON manifest plus workout files, hostable on any static host) and your planned workouts appear in the watch's native Workout app automatically. Diff-based sync preserves completion state, background refresh keeps the schedule stocked, and disconnecting cleans up everything the app scheduled.

privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Used to schedule planned workouts onto your Apple Watch.
